name: Document - Processing Time Dashboard
description: Phân tích thời gian xử lý văn bản từ khi nhận đến khi đóng

cards.name: Thời gian xử lý trung bình (ngày)

native.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (closed_at - created_at))/86400), 1) as avg_days FROM doc_documents WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND status = 'CLOSED' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'

cards.name: Thời gian xử lý theo loại văn bản

native.query: SELECT doc_type, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (closed_at - created_at))/86400), 1) as avg_days FROM doc_documents WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND status = 'CLOSED' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY doc_type ORDER BY avg_days DESC

SELECT date_trunc('month', created_at) as month, COUNT(*) as overdue FROM doc_documents WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND expiry_date < NOW() AND status NOT IN ('CLOSED','ARCHIVED') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
